newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaha to sell special version of electric bike.
newsitem.headline: Yamaha to sell special version of electric bike.

text.p: Yamaha Motor Co Ltd said on Wednesday it will sell a special, limited version of its electric power-assisted bicycle.

The special version will offer additional features worth 10,000 yen, including a powerful rear brake, light aluminium pedals and a special bamboo-like front basket, but the price, at 92,000 yen, will be only 4,200 yen more than standard models, a Yamaha spokesman said.
Yamaha will sell only 3,000 of the special-edition bicycles. It plans to sell a total of 120,000 electric power-assisted bicycles in the year to March 1998, up from 60,000 in 1996/97.

Demand for electric power-assisted bicycles in Japan is expected to reach 200,000 units in 1997/98, up from 100,000 the year before, and is projected to reach 500,000 units by 2000, the spokesman said.
